Subject: POC Kickoff — proposed times, success criteria, and owners

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for the time last week. The team at Finovate sounded aligned on running a short POC to validate low-latency retrieval+generation for your customer support routing use case. To move to a kickoff we need to align on schedules across AE / SE / your engineering + procurement + security.

Proposed kickoff windows (90 min):
- Tue 2026-03-02 10:00–11:30 PST
- Tue 2026-03-02 10:30–12:00 PST
- Wed 2026-03-03 13:00–14:30 PST

Suggested kickoff agenda (90 min):
1) Introductions & scope (10m) — owners: Marissa (AE) / Anita (Finovate)
2) Success criteria & go/no-go (15m) — owners: Marissa / Finovate eng lead
3) Architecture walk & infra pre-reqs (25m) — owner: Sergio (SE)
4) Security & data handling checklist (15m) — owner: Priya (Redwood security)
5) Procurement next steps + timelines (10m) — owner: Finovate procurement
6) Action items & timeline (15m)

Success criteria (examples):
- End-to-end inference latency < 300ms P95 on a 2k token window for our model variant
- <5% variance in top-1 routing accuracy versus your golden set
- Demonstrable KV/prefix caching with 30% token cost reduction

Please confirm which of the three slots works best and include the names/emails for your procurement and security reps so we can loop them in. I’m attaching a short MutualActionPlan (high level timeline and owners) for reference. Also attaching a technical checklist that Sergio will share (POC-checklist.pdf).

If you want, we can do a 30-min procurement pre-call immediately before the kickoff (many customers prefer it).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
